title: The Storage Room Murder
motive_summary: Nadia Cole betrayed Marcus Bell regarding a vital partnership agreement.
overview_text: 07:17 — Nadia Cole found dead in Priya's Flat by Elias Grant. Several villagers passed nearby around that time; no one claims to have seen what happened. The morning can be rewound from 05:05.
